title: Three Marks mod account binding
description: POST /mod/bind, unsigned JSON. The site shows a signed-in user a one-time code (10 chars from the alphabet below, TTL ~10 minutes, single use, rate-limited per IP and per account). The user types it into the mod; the mod posts it with the in-game account id. The server MUST reject the request unless account_id equals the Lesta account linked (via Lesta ID OpenID) to the site user who generated the code, otherwise anyone could bind someone else's account. On success the server creates a device (one per install; re-binding the same account revokes nothing else) and returns device_id and secret once. The secret is never sent again; the mod stores it locally in mods/configs/otmetki/credentials.json and uses the UTF-8 bytes of the secret string as the HMAC-SHA256 key for /mod/ingest. Users can list and revoke devices on the site.

code.description: Uppercase, no 0/O/1/I. The mod strips spaces and hyphens and uppercases before sending.

secret.description: High-entropy random string, at least 32 bytes of entropy, e.g. base64url of 32 random bytes.

account_id.description: Echo of the bound account; the mod rejects the response if it differs from the request.

revoked_device_ids.description: Present when the bind pushed the user over the per-user device cap (5): the oldest active devices it revoked, so the mod can tell the player another install was signed out.

error.description: 4xx response. 400 invalid_code for any refused code (bad format, unknown, used, expired or bound to another account: the server does not say which), 429 rate_limited (per IP, and per account after repeated failures). The other codes are kept for older servers.
